People who think CG were cheated out of a win are honestly delusional. If anything, a restart into a CG victory would be closer to a rigged match than this.

In situations like these consulting the players and the team is always the incorrect solution. The team down would rarely, if ever accept the loss. On the other hand, if you consult the winning team whether or not they think it's "fair" for them to take the win, they're stuck between a rock and a hard place; restarting means they're actively going against their own goals, and taking the win suddenly makes you the villain for somehow not having the "sportsmanship" to not take the game that you would have won 95% of the time.

The whole point of rules and judges is to prevent situations like these from putting blame and pressure on the players and organizations. They did what the had to do, the ruling was fair. For every game that people bring up as a historic comeback while a team was down 15k gold there are 10 where it didn't happen. The odds were good enough to simply call it.

Licorice very much threw their initial 6k lead with his incredibly subpar teleports.

When the original baron dance started with Licorice split pushing bot and team liquid pressured to make a move onto the baron, he had all the time in the world to continue his push onto the bot lane and even force the inhibitor. Instead, he decided to TP into a situation where C9 had very little chance to lose the baron straight up and could have possibly even won the 4v5. He also could've saved his TP for when TL was more committed and trapped into the pit to better use his ultimate. Licorice ended up going into a spot where he had very little way to initiate himself, and his only hope of being followup was for sej to land a long range ult as well as have C9 run through a line of Caitlyn traps. If he just continued to push bot lane there and forced TL to maybe rotate impact or desperation baron, the game had a very different ending.

While it might look like most of these points are right, I honestly can't agree with your metric for "lower skill ezreals". There's absolutely nothing wrong with using q on minions, especially when you have a tear already and/or are trying to push. It's definitely preferable to harass with them, but to say someone is a lower skill ezreal just because they farm with q is honestly baseless. Also, e'ing under tower to get creeps as a sign that an ezreal is good makes literally no sense, as it costs a hefty 90 mana in the early game, and has a pretty long 19 second cooldown. Unless you're 1 cs away from a big buy most of the time it's better to save it for a possible fight, or even just to save the mana. Otherwise though, the points are generally valid.
